description.en: Token saving engine: turn-based hierarchical output tiering, tool-result hash deduplication, a KV-cache-safe prompt slot, a loop breaker with a thinking watchdog, prior-session recall through the harness FTS5 index, and a bridge to the microsoft/TokenEconomizer stdlib-only Python engine (pinned commit). CLI: dsh-te.
description.zh: 令牌节约引擎：基于回合的分层输出分级、工具结果哈希去重、KV 缓存安全提示槽位、带思考看门狗的循环断路器、通过 harness FTS5 索引召回先前会话，并桥接 microsoft/TokenEconomizer 仅用标准库的 Python 引擎（锁定提交）。命令行：dsh-te。
